initial_receipt.explanation: The downstream priority output has upstream_rank 0 for every record because the evidence_sources handoff from job_1 uses source IDs as record_id values. The required handoff must preserve record identities so job_2 can join coverage records n06-r01..n06-r08 to provenance ranks. The supplied source localizes this to assemble_provenance, which constructs each provenance row with record_id set from source_id instead of the original record_id.
